version.changelog: Simplify the login instructions to the code flow (maton login prints a link; finish with maton login --code <CODE>), drop the API Key subsection, and pin the Maton CLI install to 0.4.0.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Google Slides integration that uses Maton OAuth and optional automation features with explicit approval and scoping guidance.

dimensions.detail: Network access, OAuth, OS credential-store use, and an API-key fallback are expected for this integration; the artifact includes handling rules to avoid exposing credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned Maton CLI via npm or Homebrew and optional pinned SDK packages; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned but requires trusting Maton's tooling.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions default to read/list calls, require user confirmation for connection creation and every write, and limit undocumented endpoints to user-named requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill documents hosted functions, triggers, destinations, and local watch execution, but frames them as non-default automation requiring separate user approval, narrow scope, and cleanup.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The documented capabilities match the stated purpose: Google Slides API access for creating, reading, and modifying presentations through Maton-managed authentication.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable authorizing Maton to access the selected Google Slides account. Use the narrowest Google scopes available, approve writes and automations only after reviewing the exact target and payload, and avoid raw API keys unless the CLI cannot be used.
